# foreman_media (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_media" "centos_mirror" {
  name = "CentOS Mirror"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the media to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location_ids` (Set of Number) REPLACE locations with given ids
- `operatingsystem_ids` (Set of Number)
- `organization_ids` (Set of Number) REPLACE organizations with given ids.
- `os_family` (String) Operating system family, available values: AIX, Altlinux, Archlinux, Coreos, Debian, Fcos, Freebsd, Gentoo, Junos, NXOS, Rancheros, Redhat, Rhcos, Solaris, Suse, VRP, Windows, Xenserver
- `path` (String) The path to the medium, can be a URL or a valid NFS server (exclusive of the architecture).  for example mirror.centos.org/centos/$version/os/$arch where $arch will be substituted for the host&#39;s actual OS architecture and $version, $major and $minor will be substituted for the version of the operating system.  Solaris and Debian media may also use $release.
